container.description: Absolute path inside the container where the host path is mounted

shift.description: Override UID/GID shifting for this mount (maps to `incus config device add … shift=<v>`). Unset inherits the session-wide decision the workspace uses. true forces an idmapped mount so host files appear owned by the container 'code' user instead of nobody:nogroup; false opts the mount out. Ignored on containers using raw.idmap (mutually exclusive; raw.idmap already remaps the mount).
